      PzFit(double intercept, double slope, double rms, boolean[] kept)
      Creates a fit result.
      Parameters:
      intercept - initial p/z in bara
      slope - p/z decline per unit cumulative production (bara per Sm3)
      rms - root-mean-square residual of the kept points in bara
      kept - mask of points used in the final fit
